hints: Watch bulb A when bulb B joins. Did it really get dimmer, or did it stay as bright?

Each bulb has its own path straight to the battery. The battery gives every path the same push. Add a path and the battery simply sends out more electricity. Think of a water tank with two taps. Open the second tap, and the first still flows as before.
Add a third bulb beside the other two and run it again. Keep your eye on bulb A.
